source_paper: Wei et al., Robotics and Computer-Integrated Manufacturing (RCIM) 2024, DOI: 10.1016/j.rcim.2024.102741

copied_files.modification: ARCHIVE_DIR hardcoded relative to old project root -> PHM2010_RAW_ROOT env var (default <repo>/data/PHM2010/raw/). No CWT/resample/normalization logic changed. Function name load_raw_signal unchanged; module renamed preprocessing.py -> signal_preprocessing.py (avoid clashing with stdlib-adjacent 'preprocessing' import ambiguity across methods).

Replaced live sys.path import of 代码/main_experiment_3_fgds_psi_optimized.py with a vendored, self-contained copy of define_condition_relative_stages/split_grouped_lifecycle (fixes self-containment violation, task spec section 38). split_grouped_lifecycle generalized to take explicit train_conditions/test_condition parameters instead of hardcoded C1+C4->C6, matching the exact logic already validated in the old project's final_statistical_evidence/scripts/methods/condition_split.py::make_split_fn for D2/D3 (task spec section 35: task/seed routing changes are allowed; label-definition/threshold logic is byte-for-byte unchanged).

Protocol B (run_protocol_b) logic re-expressed as MethodAdapter hooks (prepare/build_model/train/predict) instead of a standalone function; PROTO_B_CFG['seed']=42 hardcoded constant replaced with self.seed (CLI-driven TRAIN_SEED, task spec sections 22-23) -- all other hyperparameters (max_epochs=100, patience=15, batch_size=64, lr=0.001, weight_decay=1e-4) unchanged. Metric computation switched from the old dcpsr_base.manuscript_metric_row to shared/metrics/metrics.py (bit-exact verified against the old formula on real D1 RF predictions, see parent session's cross-check). Protocol A (original-paper 70/30 sanity split) and the old pre-built-275MB-npy-cache dependency were NOT ported -- this repo only needs Unified Protocol B (D1/D2/D3), and code/dataset.py now builds+caches CWT images on demand instead of requiring a separate full-dataset pre-build step.

adaptation_notes: Only task/seed/output routing and cross-platform paths were changed, per task spec section 35. Architecture (model.py), CWT preprocessing math (signal_preprocessing.py), stage-label thresholds/logic (dcpsr_labels.py), and all training hyperparameters (config.yaml) are unchanged from the original published-baseline reproduction. No pretrained weights or external assets used.
